correctness.rationale: The graph is exactly 33 vertices with 66 categorical-product edges and all independent face sets were exhaustively reconstructed (732802 including empty). An independent eight-state cyclic transfer count reproduces each of the 16 face-size coefficients. Independent native Python reconstruction, not execution of opaque source code, built both ascending and descending stage matchings: each has 366383 pairs and unmatched faces in dimensions -1:1, 0:1, 6:18, 7:16. For each, a complete Kahn sort of the 732802-face directed Hasse graph validated acyclicity over 5573766 incidences. Recursion from signed simplicial boundaries rebuilt both 18×16 Morse matrices with the same entries as the supplied JSON certificate. Independent SymPy integer Smith normal form yielded exactly fifteen unit entries and one zero for both. The acyclic Morse CW model has no cells in dimensions 1–5, so its 6-skeleton is a bouquet of 18 S6. By π6(∨18S6)=Z18 and unimodular degree-one cancellation, 15 six/seven-cell pairs cancel, leaving ∨3 S6 ∨ S7; integral torsion vanishes. This proves exactly the finite C11 × K3 statement, not a family theorem.
residual_risks: The check does not classify equivariant automorphism actions or any other cycle length; ordinary homotopy only.
Exact finite computational proof depends on successful execution of the reconstructed exhaustive combinatorial algorithm; no Lean/formal or external expert attestation is represented.

value.rationale: This is the next natural 3r+2 cycle-length instance after C8 for the explicit integral torsion question in Antolín Camarena–Carnero Bravo (2023/2024), and it gives the exact previously undetermined homotopy type of a canonical 33-vertex categorical graph product. The two sphere multiplicities and absence of Moore summands are natural integral invariants not forced by the degree-support theorem or by m=7,8,10. A complete 732802-face finite classification is mathematically substantive without needing a general theorem; scope is correctly bounded.
residual_risks: One additional finite instance does not settle the all-length torsion conjecture.
Significance is a resolved natural finite benchmark, not a claimed sweeping structural theorem.

limitations: Only the specified 11-cycle × three-color categorical product, ordinary integral homotopy; no uniform m,n theorem or symmetry action.
Sage logs in the cited source and saved verification_output.txt were not used as substitutes for independent exhaustive check.
Remaining literature priority risk from possible unindexed theorem/table; originality is best-of-knowledge, not absolute independence or third-party certification.
